target.title: fix(channels): prevent progress draft flashes when narration clears
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users receiving channel progress drafts could still see a progress draft appear before the initial progress delay when the progress narrator clears its text after a pending tool event.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared progress compositor now clears stored narration immediately but does not render the raw fallback while the progress gate is still pending. The existing delayed gate remains responsible for rendering fallback tool progress if the turn lasts long enough, keeping the fix inside the shared channel progress boundary without adding config or channel-specific policy.

## User Impact

Fast turns no longer flash a raw tool-progress draft just because narration stopped before the progress delay elapsed. Longer turns still show the normal fallback progress once the delay gate opens.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: pending tool progress followed by narration and an empty narration clear stays silent until the initial delay expires, then renders the raw fallback progress through the existing gate.
- Current-head focused proof at 63051a0da10f2bd38d775bf2499e30e151d6b2ec: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/channels/progress-draft-compositor.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 17 tests.
- LOC ratchet proof at 63051a0da10f2bd38d775bf2499e30e151d6b2ec: `node --import tsx scripts/check-ts-max-loc.ts --base upstream/main --head HEAD` passed with 1 changed production file.
- Branch diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed. Merge-refresh also pulled in current `upstream/main` so the unrelated `scripts/check-control-ui-performance.mjs` lint failure fixed by #106377 is no longer on the PR base.
- Observed result: empty narration clears no longer bypass the progress gate; the delayed gate later renders the fallback tool line only if the turn survives the configured progress delay.
